newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-CONTROVERSIAL EFFENBERG FINED FOR ASSAULT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CONTROVERSIAL EFFENBERG FINED FOR ASSAULT.

text.p: A German court on Friday found Borussia Moenchengladbach's controversial captain Stefan Effenberg and his wife guilty of assaulting a man outside their home.

The court fined the couple 390,000 marks ($220,000) for the attack on a 57-year-old metalworker last December. The former German international had denied the accusations that he and his wife had kicked and insulted the man.
Effenberg's career has been packed with controversy.
The midfielder was sent home from the 1994 World Cup finals in the United States after making an obscene gesture at German fans during a first-round match. He has not played for his country since.
